newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Cifra lowered to hold.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Cifra lowered to hold.

text.p: -- Robert Fleming Inc said it lowered its rating on Mexican retailer Cifra SA to hold from long-term buy.
-- Analyst Marc de Speville said French retailer Carrefour's hypermarkets in Mexico are proving much more popular than Wal-Mart Supercenters. Cifra is in a joint venture with Wal-Mart in Mexico.
-- "Carrefour has recently increased its expansion plan for Mexico and is now deliberately targeting Wal-Mart's Supercenters when choosing new locations," the analyst said.
-- "We do, however, still believe Wal-Mart will be successful in Latin America in the long-term," he added.
-- Cifra's B shares were up 0.17 percent on the Mexican Bolsa in late trade.
